definitions.controlled_buildup: No possession regain in the window; >=5 passes, >=85% completed, mean pass length <=20 m, starts in own half (x<=40), net forward progress >=12 m at <=3.0 m/s, window >=14 s, no cross/cutback and no shot.
definitions.direct_progression: No regain; mean pass length >=24 m, >=2 long forward passes (>=25 m long and >=18 m forward), net forward progress >=35 m at >=3.0 m/s.
definitions.wide_attack: No regain; >=60% of ball events end in wide channels (|y-50|>30), net forward progress >=25 m, and >=1 cross or cutback (a backward pass from the wide byline area x>=85 into the centre). (Not direct_progression.)
definitions.central_progression: No regain; <=30% of ball events end in wide channels, net forward progress >=25 m, no cross, mean pass length <24 m. (Not controlled_buildup / direct_progression.)
definitions.high_press_turnover: Own possession regained (tackle won / recovery) in the opponent half (x>=55) after >=1 opponent pass and >=2 own pressure events in the 5 events before the regain.
definitions.counterattack: Own possession regained in own half or midfield (x<55), then >=35 m forward progression at >=3.5 m/s within <=14 s using <=4 passes.
definitions.other_or_uncertain: Everything that satisfies none of the rules above: sterile/lateral possession, mixed channels, regains without a fast or pressed follow-up, failed long balls, wide play without a cross, ...

note: Labels are outputs of documented numeric rules applied to SYNTHETIC event sequences. They are not expert annotations or objective football truth.
